description_zh: 调用DeleteJobs删除指定集群中一个或多个作业
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc delete-jobs --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --jobs Id_:_0.sched0000_,_Id_:_1.sched0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteJobs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of jobs that you want to delete. Maximum number of jobs: 100. Minimum number of jobs: 1.

Format: `[{"Id": "0.sched****"},{"Id": "1.sched****"}]`. Separate multiple jobs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87251.html operation to query the job ID
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的作业ID列表，作业数量取值范围：1~100。

格式为`[{"Id": "0.sched****"},{"Id": "1.sched****"}]`，多个作业间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87251.html查询作业ID
parameters.name: jobs

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous link to delete the jobs.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
采用异步消息链路删除作业。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
